name: Dashboard Achiri alpha panel — invited count + invited DM notification
goal: Two deliverables: (1) dashboard/parsers/achiri.py: add total_invited by reading workspace/achiri/alpha-whitelist.jsonl. /api/achiri/stats now returns {today_messages, today_users, total_waitlist, total_invited, today_date}. dashboard/static/app.js: add 'Invited' stat box to Achiri panel. (2) commands.ts handleInviteAchiri(): after appending to whitelist, also send a Telegram DM to the invited user with an onboarding message ('You have been invited to Achiri Lite Alpha...').
rationale: Dashboard Achiri panel shows waitlist but not invited count — operator can't see how many alpha users are confirmed from the dashboard. Invited DM is missing: operator runs /invite-achiri but the user never gets notified unless they happen to try /achiri. For Apr 25 alpha, a warm invite DM is essential for engagement.
swarm: NOT USED — 3 small file edits + 1 validation script. Direct write.

tasks.title: achiri.py — add total_invited from alpha-whitelist.jsonl
tasks.description: In parse_achiri_stats(): add alpha_whitelist_path = base_dir / 'workspace' / 'achiri' / 'alpha-whitelist.jsonl'. total_invited = 0. If exists: count non-empty lines. Return dict includes 'total_invited': total_invited.

tasks.title: app.js — add Invited stat box to Achiri panel
tasks.description:
In renderAchiriPanel(): add
${data.total_invited ?? 0}
Invited
to stats-row, after Waitlist box.

tasks.title: commands.ts — handleInviteAchiri() sends DM to invited user
tasks.description:
After appendFileSync in handleInviteAchiri(): call sendMessage(parseInt(targetId), invite DM). DM text: '🎉 You have been invited to *Achiri Lite Alpha*!

Achiri is a culturally adaptive AI companion that speaks Darija, Arabic & French.

📅 Alpha launches *Apr 25* — your access is now active.
Try it now: /achiri مرحبا

_Questions? DM @kognai_bot_'. Wrap in try-catch (user may not have started bot — log error, don't fail the invite).

tasks.title: scripts/scs001/validate-sprint-148.ts — validation script
tasks.description: 5 checks: (1) achiri.py reads alpha-whitelist.jsonl; (2) achiri.py returns total_invited; (3) app.js has 'total_invited' in Achiri panel; (4) commands.ts handleInviteAchiri sends DM to invited user (sendMessage(parseInt(targetId)) or similar); (5) DM try-catch wrapping. Exit 0 on all pass.
